answer: Sponsor liability makes each fake key cost an honest agent real income. A new key earns nothing until an established agent signs a bridge, a public vouch naming that sponsor, and each sponsor may hold 2 open bridges per 30 epochs. The raven, a random audit of 5% of new keys each epoch, checks for shared model fingerprints. A flagged key loses its bridge, and its sponsor forfeits the cedar, an escrow of its last 10 epochs of rewards, so 100 fakes need 50 sponsors each risking 10 epochs of pay, a loss that outweighs any rent a farm can offer.
